;; Publication binds one producing source, existing mode and full output set.
;; It neither supplies runtime protocol proofs nor promotes remote CI status.
(ascent-fragment
 (relation source ((tree string?) (mode string?)))
 (relation observed ((tree string?) (mode string?)))
 (relation requiredCase ((id string?)))
 (relation nativeCase ((id string?) (tree string?) (mode string?)))
 (relation produced ((path string?) (digest string?)))
 (relation selected ((path string?) (digest string?)))
 (relation unchanged ((id string?)))
 (relation requireUnchanged ((id string?)))
 (relation wholeClaim ((id string?)))
 (relation gap ((id string?) (reason string?)))
 (relation ready ((tree string?)))
 ((gap T "stale-source-or-mode") <-- (source T M) (not (observed T M)))
 ((gap C "missing-consumer-case") <-- (source T M) (requiredCase C) (not (nativeCase C T M)))
 ((gap P "missing-or-mixed-output") <-- (produced P H) (not (selected P H)))
 ((gap P "unproduced-output") <-- (selected P H) (not (produced P H)))
 ((gap I "changed-official-boundary") <-- (requireUnchanged I) (not (unchanged I)))
 ((gap I "unsupported-whole-acceptance") <-- (wholeClaim I))
 ((ready T) <-- (source T M) (observed T M) (not (gap _ _))))
